as_told.title: Chase Brandon's novel: committee with a crystal tablet showing future timelines

plain: The Kryptos Conundrum, a book by the former CIA officer Chase Brandon, describes an intelligence committee whose members are each visited separately by non-human beings, who "paranormally show up to everybody on the committee" and coordinate them to manage humanity's timelines. Michels describes the book on two episodes. The second time he adds that the beings gave the committee "a crystal tablet that gave them access to reading future timelines." He tells it as a book that may hint at something real, coming from a CIA insider.
